claims.statement: After k successive nonzero scalar physical-coordinate Schur pivots, if T_k is the final Schur complement on untouched original coordinates, then s_{k+1}(A)<=||T_k||op.

Assume s3(A)>=1 and successive physical pivots satisfy ad<0, |a|>=3501/8000, |d|>1/8. For the second Schur complement T, either some |T_jj|>=1/2, in which case ||p_Q||inf<386.981 by the physical-triple determinant theorem, or some original-coordinate cut L|K satisfies s1(T[L,K])>1/4. In the cross branch Delta_jk=det A[{i,p,j},{i,p,k}] obeys Delta=ad T[L,K], hence s1(Delta)>3501/256000.
